header: Pick the endpoint that matches the document
subheadline: Every endpoint meters per page and no endpoint carries a monthly minimum on Sandbox. Rates step down on their own once a workspace passes 100,000 pages inside a calendar month, and the usage ledger names the tier you are billed at.

items.title: Extraction
items.description: Invoices, delivery notes, contracts and forms come back as typed JSON with a confidence score per field. EUR 0.012 per page.

items.title: Classification
items.description: Sorts a mixed inbox into the right queue before extraction runs, using 40 built-in types or your own labels. EUR 0.004 per page.

items.title: Redaction
items.description: Names, IBANs and card numbers masked in the stored copy, with one audit entry per document. EUR 0.006 per page.
